scope: Generic commutative algebra and affine-line geometry adapted into the independent CCDN library. No Pierce imports or application-specific counting assumptions. Original copyright and author headers retained.

files.changes: Namespace/import adaptation; HilbertLinearity omits both final Pierce-specific component theorems and uses existing CCDN finite-powers independence API
Generic critical-growth module, algebraic_eq_scalar helper, and affine_of_critical_growth_of_point; namespace/import adaptation.

Ported coordinate multiplication, affine-coordinate polynomial containment, rational-point coordinate and line classification; reused existing monotonicity and prime-point infrastructure. Added fixed-direction polynomial identity, full zero-set equality, and HasAffineCurveDegree interface. Omitted the redundant algebraically-closed wrappers.

changes: Generic arguments only; all Pierce-specific curve equations and counting statements excluded.
